A day for each feast

Thanksgiving Day (United States)

A Heartfelt Thanksgiving at Home

Gather your loved ones for a day of gratitude, delicious food, and cherished traditions, all from the comfort of your home. This agenda helps you savor every moment of Thanksgiving Day.

  1. Morning

    Parade Spectacle

    Start your day by tuning into the festive Thanksgiving Day Parade. Enjoy the giant balloons and lively performances, a beloved tradition that sets a joyful tone for the day.

  2. Late Morning

    Main Course Preparations

    Begin the heart of your Thanksgiving meal. Get the turkey ready for roasting and start preparing your flavorful cornbread stuffing, filling your home with wonderful aromas.

    Recipes: Roast Turkey · Classic Cornbread Stuffing

  3. Early Afternoon

    Crafting the Classic Sides

    While the turkey roasts, turn your attention to the essential side dishes. Prepare the vibrant cranberry relish, creamy sweet potatoes, and the comforting green bean casserole.

    Recipes: Classic Homemade Cranberry Relish · Sweet Potato Casserole with Pecan Topping · Classic Green Bean Casserole

  4. Mid-Afternoon

    A Moment of Gratitude

    Gather your household for a gratitude circle. Share what you are thankful for, reflecting on the blessings of the year, a meaningful tradition before the feast.

  5. Late Afternoon

    The Grand Thanksgiving Feast

    It's time to enjoy the fruits of your labor! Serve your beautifully roasted turkey, savory stuffing, and all the delicious sides. Gather around the table and share this special meal.

    Recipes: Roast Turkey · Classic Cornbread Stuffing · Classic Homemade Cranberry Relish · Sweet Potato Casserole with Pecan Topping · Classic Green Bean Casserole

  6. Evening

    Sweet Endings and Relaxation

    After dinner, indulge in traditional pumpkin or pecan pie. Settle in to watch a football game, a classic way to unwind and enjoy the evening.

    Recipes: Classic Thanksgiving Pumpkin Pie

  7. Late Evening

    Reflect and Relax

    As the day winds down, enjoy the quiet moments, perhaps with leftovers or a warm drink, cherishing the memories made and the spirit of togetherness.

May your Thanksgiving be filled with warmth, good food, and cherished company.
